intent: minimal edits of installed project master
user_feedback: 感觉和现在的不是一个肤色和风格

outputs.name: 清正·后收束发
outputs.detail: Replace hair with a soft swept-back hairstyle exposing the forehead and both ears, all length gathered into one low compact coil at the nape, slightly visible behind the viewer-left ear. No long hair over either shoulder or two hanging cheek curtains. Fine soft wisps like image1. Eyebrows gently straighter while keeping their original slender-natural weight; clear modest long almond eyes, no pressure from a heavy brow.
outputs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit IMAGE 1 minimally. Image1 is the EXACT already-approved and installed PROJECT MALE MASTER, and is the absolute authority for skin color, face/neck proportions, drawing hand, colors, lighting, clothing and composition. This is a closely matching modular variant, not a new illustration style.
Image2 is the CURRENT ACTIVE face/ears/neck skin layer from this project. It is only a binding skin color, soft skin texture and head shape reference. Keep a normally complete face in the result, not the bald/blank reference layer.
CRITICAL USER CORRECTION: previous newly generated variants became redder/oranger/darker, stronger black hair, sharper shading and looked like a different project. Match image1 and image2 directly. Keep the exact LIGHT, DESATURATED, subtly pale rosy-beige skin already present in image1; preserve its soft grey-beige shadow values, faint paper/fabric-like brushed texture and subdued contrast. Do not add orange/tan coloring, pink cheek blush, yellow cast, sunburn, sharpened cheek/nose planes, photoreal pores, strong 3D modeling or commercial glossy portrait retouching.
Preserve image1 face silhouette, ears, forehead size, jaw/chin position, nose, mouth, exposed neck, neckline and relative eye positions. Do not repaint the face as a different skin or beautify it into a glossy handsome actor. All unedited skin regions must remain as close to the supplied source as possible.
Allowed edits: change the hairstyle silhouette to the design below, and make ONLY a subtle new eyebrow/eyelid shape with the SAME fine, low-contrast drawing hand and natural project eye size. Keep eyes at image1's size and position; equal pair, no enlarged anime eyes, no thick ink wings. Keep nose and mouth as they already are for a compatible existing-part family. Attractive, calm, upright masculine expression with restraint.
HAIR COLOR AND QUALITY: exactly image1's muted warm charcoal/grey-brown fine ink strands, soft low-contrast highlights and airy strand edges. No jet-black fill masses, white metallic hair streaks, high contrast, shiny synthetic strands, or hard comic outlines. Hair can be structurally different but must have exactly the same artist hand, color and fine strand scale as image1.
Do not refer to Tale of Immortal/鬼谷八荒 or any external art style. Image1 is the painting authority.
Retain image1's existing green-and-gold robe, embroidery, muted colors, entire body, pose, framing and paper beige background as close as possible. Keep existing skin from forehead to neck continuous, with no color shift where new eyebrow or hair meets it.
Output ONE 1024x1536 portrait; opaque background, no text, no labels, no collage, no props.
DESIGN: Replace hair with a soft swept-back hairstyle exposing the forehead and both ears, all length gathered into one low compact coil at the nape, slightly visible behind the viewer-left ear. No long hair over either shoulder or two hanging cheek curtains. Fine soft wisps like image1. Eyebrows gently straighter while keeping their original slender-natural weight; clear modest long almond eyes, no pressure from a heavy brow.

outputs.name: 温雅·斜扫低尾
outputs.detail: Replace hair with a restrained diagonal sweep over the upper forehead and one LOW loose ponytail descending behind the viewer-left shoulder. One short irregular forelock at one temple only, both eyes unobstructed, no pair of hanging side locks. Keep fine soft strands. Very slightly softer eyebrow arch and gently relaxed eye contour, the same eye size and opening as image1. Keep the original nose and lips.
